BOARD MEETING MINUTES
Marbledock & Associates
Date: April 15, 2025
Location: Marbledock & Associates Headquarters, Conference Room A
Meeting called to order at: 9:00 AM
Meeting adjourned at: 11:45 AM

ATTENDEES
- Margaret Holvan, Chief Executive Officer (Chair)
- Pierre Dubois, Chief Financial Officer
- Aiyana Park, Head of Operations

RECORDER: Clara Venn, Executive Assistant

---

AGENDA ITEM 1: APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES
Margaret Holvan opened the meeting and invited members to review the minutes from the March 18, 2025 board meeting. Pierre Dubois noted a minor correction to the Q1 revenue figure cited on page 3. The correction was acknowledged and incorporated.
DECISION: The minutes from the March 18, 2025 board meeting were approved as amended, with unanimous consent from all three board members.

---

AGENDA ITEM 2: Q1 2025 FINANCIAL REVIEW
Pierre Dubois presented the Q1 2025 financial report. Key highlights included:
- Total revenue of $4.2 million, representing a 12% increase year-over-year.
- Operating expenses of $2.8 million, within the approved budget.
- Net profit margin of 33%, up from 29% in Q1 2024.
- Cash reserves standing at $1.6 million, providing approximately 6 months of operating runway.
Dubois flagged a 7% increase in vendor costs and recommended a review of supplier contracts in Q2. He also noted that accounts receivable aging had improved, with 91% of outstanding invoices collected within 45 days.
DECISION: The board approved the Q1 2025 financial report as presented. Pierre Dubois is authorized to initiate a formal review of all vendor contracts with a value exceeding $50,000 annually, with findings to be reported at the May board meeting.

---

AGENDA ITEM 3: CLIENT ACCOUNT UPDATE — NORTHWIND PARTNERS
Margaret Holvan introduced the Northwind Partners agenda item, citing the account's strategic importance to Marbledock & Associates. Aiyana Park delivered a comprehensive status update.
Park reported that Northwind Partners had formally requested an expansion of the current service agreement to include strategic consulting services in addition to the existing operational support retainer. The expanded scope would represent an estimated $600,000 in additional annual revenue. However, Park noted that fulfilling this expansion would require dedicating two senior consultants full-time to the account and potentially onboarding one additional specialist.
Dubois confirmed that the financial modeling supports the expansion, projecting a net margin of approximately 28% on the new scope after staffing costs. Holvan emphasized the importance of maintaining service quality for Northwind Partners, given their referral potential within the industry.
A concern was raised regarding timeline: Northwind Partners had requested commencement of expanded services by June 1, 2025, which Park considered aggressive but feasible with immediate action on staffing.
DECISION: The board unanimously approved acceptance of the Northwind Partners scope expansion. Aiyana Park is authorized to negotiate and finalize the amended service agreement by April 30, 2025. HR is to be notified immediately to begin recruitment for one specialist consultant. Pierre Dubois will prepare a revised budget allocation reflecting the new contract by May 5, 2025.

---

AGENDA ITEM 4: OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY INITIATIVE — Q2 ROLLOUT
Aiyana Park presented the phased rollout plan for the Operational Efficiency Initiative previously approved in January 2025. Phase 1, covering internal process audits, was completed on schedule. Phase 2 will focus on technology integration, specifically the adoption of a unified project management platform across all departments.
Park proposed a platform selection deadline of April 25, 2025, followed by a staff training period in May, with full deployment targeted for June 2025. Three platforms were shortlisted: Asana Enterprise, Monday.com Business, and an internal custom build. Park recommended Monday.com Business based on cost, scalability, and integration capabilities.
DECISION: The board approved the adoption of Monday.com Business as the firm-wide project management platform. Aiyana Park is authorized to execute the procurement agreement up to a budget of $35,000 for the first year, including onboarding and training. A company-wide deployment memo is to be issued by May 1, 2025.

---

AGENDA ITEM 5: TALENT ACQUISITION AND RETENTION STRATEGY
Margaret Holvan led a discussion on talent retention following the voluntary departure of two senior associates in Q1 2025. Holvan noted that exit interviews indicated compensation competitiveness and career development opportunities as primary concerns. Dubois presented a compensation benchmarking summary indicating that Marbledock & Associates salaries at the senior associate level were approximately 8–11% below the industry median.
The board discussed options including merit-based salary adjustments, a structured mentorship program, and the introduction of a performance bonus framework tied to client satisfaction scores.
DECISION: The board approved a targeted salary adjustment pool of up to $180,000 to address compensation gaps at the senior associate and consultant levels, effective July 1, 2025. Pierre Dubois and Aiyana Park are jointly tasked with developing a performance bonus framework proposal for board review at the June 2025 meeting.

---

AGENDA ITEM 6: ANY OTHER BUSINESS AND NEXT MEETING DATE
Margaret Holvan noted that the firm has been approached by two prospective clients in the renewable energy sector and directed Aiyana Park to prepare preliminary capability assessments for both prospects before the next meeting. No further business was raised.
DECISION: The next board meeting is scheduled for May 20, 2025, at 9:00 AM. Margaret Holvan will circulate the draft agenda no later than May 13, 2025.

---

MEETING ADJOURNED
The meeting was adjourned at 11:45 AM by Margaret Holvan.

Minutes recorded by: Clara Venn, Executive Assistant
Approved by: Margaret Holvan, CEO
Date of approval: April 16, 2025
